en.headline: Dump truck collides with lorry on Yuen Long Highway, driver injured
en.dek: The collision near Fuk Hang Tsuen around 9:20 a.m. left the lorry driver briefly trapped; some lanes towards Yuen Long remain closed.
body: A dump truck collided with a 5.5-tonne lorry on Yuen Long Highway on Wednesday morning, injuring the lorry driver.
The accident happened at about 9:20 a.m. near Fuk Hang Tsuen on the section heading towards Yuen Long. The lorry’s windscreen was shattered and the driver was briefly trapped before being freed.
He was conscious when taken to hospital. The cause of the collision is under investigation.
The Transport Department said some lanes on Yuen Long Highway towards Yuen Long near Fuk Hang Tsuen remained closed, and traffic was congested.

zh.headline: 元朗公路泥頭車與貨車相撞 司機受傷
zh.dek: 早上約9時20分，往元朗方向近福亨村發生碰撞，貨車司機一度被困，部分行車線仍然封閉。
body: 元朗公路發生交通意外。
周三早上約9時20分，一部泥頭車與一部5.5噸貨車在往元朗方向近福亨村相撞。貨車擋風玻璃破裂，司機一度被困，其後獲救。
司機清醒送院治理。意外原因有待調查。
運輸署表示，因交通意外，元朗公路往元朗方向近福亨村的部分行車線仍然封閉，現場交通擠塞。
